newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia plans to sell 1.5 pct of UES this autumn.
newsitem.headline: Russia plans to sell 1.5 pct of UES this autumn.

text.p: Russia plans to sell 1.5 percent of national power company Unified Energy System (UES) in the autumn of this year, State Property Committee chairman Alfred Kokh said on Thursday.
A committee official had said earlier this month that around one percent of the company would be sold some time in 1997. Kokh gave no further details of the planned sale.
The government owns 52.7 percent of shares in UES, and must retain ownership of 51 percent until March 31 1998.
Foreign investors own 27.8 percent of the company's shares.
The proposed sale of the stake in RAO Yedinaya Energeticheskaya Sistema Rossii (UES) is part of a series of planned sell-offs this year.
UES owns the national power grid, has controlling stakes in most regional power utilities and has stakes in a number of generating plants.
